batch_scope: BF-4: re-pin the live-safe engine wheel to a newer Yass main commit to pull in two upstream fixes that measurement/parity review found missing from the running system — the RT-std defect (b_item_response_time_std_sec persisted as 0.0 for <2 timed responses or zero variance, rejected by the B->3 contract's PositiveTiming | None) and the B-NS07 conservation delta-in-prompt fix (upstreamed to Yass first via a dedicated PR specifically so this rebuild would not have to ship a locally-modified science file — see rebuild_provenance below). No adapter wiring changed, no new scientific parameter, no change to the trim/exclusion boundary established at BE3 — this batch only moves the pin and re-verifies everything the BE3 record below already established still holds. Original BE3 packaging scope: 'Packaging and import-boundary work only. No adapter wiring, no application import, no live learner flow, no new scientific parameters. Governed by component-b-live-engine-reuse-map.json and component-b-closure-decisions.json (generator_packaging_decision.selected_strategy = MINIMAL_UPADYA_COMPONENT_B_LIVE_ENGINE_AT_BE3).'

package.build_command: python -m build --wheel --no-isolation --outdir <dist> (setuptools==80.10.2, wheel==0.46.3, build==1.2.2.post1; built inside the exact application base image docker.io/library/python:3.11.15-slim-bookworm@sha256:b18992999dbe963a45a8a4da40ac2b1975be1a776d939d098c647482bcad5cba, not a merely-compatible local interpreter — interpreter parity is the point of a hash-pinned wheel).
package.application_container_installation: WIRED since BE3b — requirements.lock installs this wheel with `pip install --require-hashes --no-deps`, and the Dockerfile COPYs it into the image at build time. This batch updates both to the new filename/hash; see requirements.lock, requirements.in, and Dockerfile.

pinned_source.git_commit_role: origin/main tip at rebuild time — Merge pull request #13 (component-b-ns07-delta-in-prompt), itself on top of Merge pull request #12 (958ab06, restore of GF-1..GF-4). 75d0216 (GF-3, fixed_hidden_growth_g) and 09267ab are both confirmed ancestors of origin/main via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, not inferred from an abbreviated hash — the repository underwent a directory flatten (Implementation_v1.0/ prefix removed) somewhere in this range, and abbreviated-SHA / prefixed-path lookups were independently found to be unreliable mid-investigation, so every path and commit used here was resolved with a full 40-character SHA and confirmed with `git cat-file -e` before being trusted.
pinned_source.verification_method: git diff 0e86fdcbc0ffcdbda3d37c742e83b1d532910e2b 09267abfe83829168b8b4817eb4c59d10f54e311 -- Implementation_v1.0/component_b_generator Implementation_v1.0/models (read-only, full SHAs), plus per-file byte comparison of every verbatim-copied file in this package against `git show <commit>:<path>`.

All 45 verbatim files in this package (the list is unchanged from BE3) were re-confirmed byte-identical to their `git show 09267abfe83829168b8b4817eb4c59d10f54e311:Implementation_v1.0/<path>` blob content.

validators_widened_closure.reason: B's original omission was CORRECT for B's own live-safe closure: its only validators consumers were adapters/*, themselves excluded. The application-level need is NEW: v3.0 Section 5 requires Component C to call validate_payload(payload, "b_to_c") and forbids re-declaring the contract, so the B->C boundary check had no implementation without it. This is a WIDENED CLOSURE AT THE SAME PIN: two files, no science change, no pin move, no new dependency (validators/contract_validators.py imports only from models.contracts, already shipped since BE3). schemas/ is not shipped: validate_payload is pure pydantic and loads no JSON schema file.
validators_widened_closure.gate: Authorised by the project owner, who states the Component B owner was notified of this change and agreed. Owner-relayed; no written sign-off record is cited.
